scripts.dev: concurrently -n sdk,checkout,demo -c blue,magenta,green "npm --workspace=@dodo/sdk run dev" "npm --workspace=@dodo/checkout run dev" "npm --workspace=@dodo/demo run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace=@dodo/sdk run build && npm --workspace=@dodo/checkout run build && npm --workspace=@dodo/demo run build
